scope: Literature-constrained AGS-101 optical-response ensemble without an authentic LQ029B1DC01F waveform measurement.

transferabilityScale.1: partial compatibility; direction or envelope use only
transferabilityScale.2: close compatibility, but still not exact-panel evidence

rules: No nearby Sharp part number is promoted to LQ029B1DC01F identity.
Manufacturer-family endpoint timings constrain an ensemble; they do not create AGS-101 measurements.
Sharp Tr is mapped from white to black and Sharp Td from black to white according to each document's response diagram, rather than by the English names of runtime variables.
Cross-product research can justify qualitative transition-distance and temperature dimensions but cannot supply an AGS-101 table cell.
Community ghosting reports remain qualitative and supply no milliseconds.
A first-order model matching a published 10-to-90 endpoint is scalar-compatible only; it is not proof of the unreported waveform shape.

items.title: Preserved LQ029B1DC01F manufacturer-specification search
items.limits: No exact manufacturer datasheet or exact-panel response waveform was located. The search result is not proof that no document exists.

items.title: Sharp LQ022B8UD04 TFT-LCD Module Product Specification LCY-303Z01
items.preservation: third-party mirror of a Sharp product specification

identity.technology: active-matrix TFT, normally-white; LC mode and transmissive/transflective classification not stated in the checked specification pages
identity.interface: integrated driver with host CPU interface

conditions.definition: 10-to-90 percent detector-output interval shown for white-to-black and black-to-white

transferability.use: fast endpoint anchor and period-family asymmetry direction

items.limits: Different part, smaller portrait panel, different resolution and integrated drive architecture. The checked specification does not state the LC mode or transmissive/transflective class. It does not identify AGS-101 behavior.

items.title: Sharp LQ030B1DC4xx/LQ030B1DC6xx TFT-LCD Module Delivery Specification LCG-02039B
items.preservation: third-party mirror of a Sharp delivery specification

identity.interface: raw parallel RGB with external timing/control

conditions.definition: 10-to-90 percent detector-output interval shown for white-to-black and black-to-white
conditions.measurementInstrument: Topcon BM-5(A), one-degree field, 350 mm, panel center

transferability.use: nominal typical endpoint and slow maximum endpoint anchors

items.limits: Different part family, 256x192 rather than 240x160, and a specification issued three years after the documented AGS-101 specimen. Values constrain a nearby family envelope only.
